question_record.context: A suspicious LDAP query was executed by user `pwilson`, indicating potential reconnaissance activity. The associated process was `ldaprequest.ps1` executed via `powershell.exe`. LDAP queries can be used by attackers to learn an organization's structure, which can lead to gaining higher privileges and access to important assets.
question_record.question: Which account SID was identified in the sensitive credential memory read alert indicating a potential attack on lsass.exe?
solution: A suspicious LDAP query was executed using the process `powershell.exe`, indicating potential reconnaissance activity.
A process accessed the memory of lsass.exe to read sensitive credentials. The compromised account has the SID `S-1-5-21-561436748-3867387497-1732241745-3701`.

64.name: Suspicious LDAP query
64.description:
A suspect LDAP (Lightweight Directory Access Protocol) query was executed, indicating potential reconnaissance activity. 

LDAP queries are often used by attackers in attempt to learn the organization's structure, by querying the domain controller for blatempistrative users and groups and interesting assets. 
Using this information, an attacker can gain higher privileges and access important assets in the organization.

67.name: Sensitive credential memory read
67.description: A process scanned or dumped memory from the Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (lsass.exe).  Accessing this process memory allows the attacker to extract secrets such as authentication hashes or passwords.  A copy of this memory may be written to the file system and exfiltrated to extract these credentials offline.
